name: io.github.yasinyaman/graphlore
title: graphlore
description: Navigate a codebase through a code graph it builds itself: semantic locate, impact, source spans.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: Installs graphlore's native engine (prebuilt wheels); graphlore_build builds the graph with it.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHLORE_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the project to explore. The server reads graphify-out/graph.json inside it.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHLORE_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: Tool surface: lean (12 core exploration tools), full (all 34) or locate (5, a locate-first surface).

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHLORE_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every path graphlore knows reaches the network.
